cases.formatted_markdown:
### ⚡ Can I use my existing 700W charger with the Ather 450S, and how long will recharging take?

**Summary:** Yes, you can use your existing 700W charger with the Ather 450S as it is backwards-compatible across all new Ather scooters. Recharging takes 3 hr 30 min (0–80%) and 4 hr 30 min (0–100%).

#### 📋 Key Takeaways
- Full compatibility: The existing 700W home charger works with the Ather 450S.
- 0% to 80% recharge duration: 3 hours 30 minutes.
- 0% to 100% full recharge duration: 4 hours 30 minutes.

#### ⚙️ Technical Specifications & Limits
- **Charger Compatibility**: 700W Home Charger (Fully Compatible)
- **0% to 80% Charge Time**: 3 hr 30 min
- **0% to 100% Charge Time**: 4 hr 30 min

#### 🛡️ Conditions & Safety Precautions
- ⚠️ Ensure charging occurs on a properly earthed 15A socket with surge protection.

cases.query: What does FallSafe do when the rider falls?
cases.direct_answer: FallSafe™ automatically cuts off power supply to the motor if the rider falls off, immediately stopping the scooter from moving. Additionally, hazard indicators flash to alert fellow road users.
key_takeaways: Motor Cutoff: Cuts off power to the drive motor immediately upon detecting a fall.
Hazard Alert: Both turn indicators blink automatically to warn surrounding traffic.
Dashboard Control: Can be toggled on/off via the dashboard, but keeping it enabled is recommended.
conditions_and_safety: Always keep FallSafe enabled for maximum road safety.
cases.formatted_markdown:
### ⚡ What does FallSafe do when the rider falls?

**Summary:** FallSafe™ automatically cuts off power supply to the motor if the rider falls off, immediately stopping the scooter from moving. Additionally, hazard indicators flash to alert fellow road users.

- Motor Cutoff: Cuts off power to the drive motor immediately upon detecting a fall.

#### ⚙️ Technical Specifications & Limits

- **Visual Alert**: Dual indicator flashing (hazard warning)
- **User Control**: Toggleable via Dashboard UI

#### 🛡️ Conditions & Safety Precautions
- ⚠️ Always keep FallSafe enabled for maximum road safety.

cases.query: What roadside assistance is described when a fully discharged battery leaves the vehicle immovable?
cases.direct_answer: If a fully discharged battery leaves your vehicle immobilized on the road, Ather Roadside Assistance (RSA) will tow your scooter to the nearest Ather touchpoint with no questions asked.
key_takeaways: Towing Service: Scooter is towed directly to the nearest official Ather touchpoint / charging station.
No Questions Asked: Coverage applies even when fully discharged mid-journey.
Warranty Note: Deep discharge caused while in an idle state is also protected under battery terms.
conditions_and_safety: Customer negligence exclusions do not penalize deep discharge from idle states.
cases.formatted_markdown:
### ⚡ What roadside assistance is described when a fully discharged battery leaves the vehicle immovable?

cases.query: What battery degradation protection is described by Eight70 Warranty?
cases.direct_answer: The Eight70 Warranty guarantees the battery for 8 years or 80,000 km, protecting against battery degradation by assuring the battery health stays above 70%—otherwise it is replaced for free.
key_takeaways: Guaranteed minimum 70% battery health (State of Health / SOH).
Free battery replacement if health drops below 70% during the warranty period.
Covers all battery defects (cells, electrical, electronic, BMS) with no upper limit on claims.
Idle state assurance protects against claim rejection due to deep discharge.
conditions_and_safety: Available as an add-on with AtherStack Pro.
Excludes unauthorized modifications, VIN/BIN tampering, and physical/water immersion damages.
cases.formatted_markdown:
### ⚡ What battery degradation protection is described by Eight70 Warranty?

**Summary:** The Eight70 Warranty guarantees the battery for 8 years or 80,000 km, protecting against battery degradation by assuring the battery health stays above 70%—otherwise it is replaced for free.

#### 📋 Key Takeaways
- 8 Years / 80,000 km warranty coverage.
- Guaranteed minimum 70% battery health (State of Health / SOH).
- Free battery replacement if health drops below 70% during the warranty period.
- Covers all battery defects (cells, electrical, electronic, BMS) with no upper limit on claims.
- Idle state assurance protects against claim rejection due to deep discharge.

#### ⚙️ Technical Specifications & Limits
- **Warranty Period**: 8 Years or 80,000 km (whichever occurs first)
- **Minimum Guaranteed Health**: 70% State of Health (SOH)
- **Remedy for Degradation**: Free Battery Pack Replacement
- **Coverage Scope**: Cells, BMS, Electronics, Electrical

#### 🛡️ Conditions & Safety Precautions
- ⚠️ Available as an add-on with AtherStack Pro.
- ⚠️ Excludes unauthorized modifications, VIN/BIN tampering, and physical/water immersion damages.
